note: Local creative software that an agent drives through CLI-Anything harnesses. Each harness is a separate Python package that wraps a real desktop app or binary and prints JSON. GDH never vendors a harness. It pins the upstream commit, probes what is installed, and installs only with the user's yes. See kit/references/tools/cli-anything.md.

clis.name: Inkscape
clis.backendNote: Inkscape on PATH. The harness edits SVG directly; export needs Inkscape.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: GIMP
clis.backendNote: GIMP on PATH, used in batch mode.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session. Use the pinned commit, not the PyPI build: the PyPI 1.0.0 upload predates the upstream fix for a Script-Fu path injection.

clis.name: Krita
clis.backendNote: Krita installed; the harness drives its export pipeline.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: Blender
clis.backendNote: Blender 4.2 or later, run in background mode with a Python script. Give it absolute output paths.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: FreeCAD
clis.backendNote: FreeCAD 1.1 or later. Parametric parts for print or CNC.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: 3MF mesh editor
clis.backendNote: No desktop app. The package pulls numpy, scipy and trimesh.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: draw.io
clis.backendNote: The draw.io desktop app for export.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: Mermaid
clis.backendNote: No local renderer. It renders through a web service.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session. The harness sends diagram text to mermaid.ink by default to render, so the diagram leaves the machine. MERMAID_RENDERER_URL points it at a self-hosted renderer.

clis.name: Kdenlive (MLT)
clis.backendNote: The MLT melt binary renders the project.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: Shotcut (MLT)
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: Openscreen
clis.backendNote: ffmpeg. Edits screen recordings: zoom, speed ramps, trim, annotations.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: LibreOffice
clis.backendNote: LibreOffice for headless conversion to PDF, PPTX and DOCX.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: ComfyUI
clis.backendNote: A ComfyUI server the user runs, on localhost:8188 by default. Models and GPU are the user's.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session. Confirm the server address points at the user's own machine before a call.

clis.name: QGIS
clis.backendNote: QGIS with qgis_process on PATH and PyQGIS importable.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: Audio (SoX)
clis.backendNote: SoX on PATH. It does not drive the Audacity app.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.

clis.name: OBS Studio
clis.backendNote: OBS Studio. Records the screen; it can capture whatever is on screen, so confirm the scene first.
clis.evidenceNote: Read from the upstream source at the pinned commit on 2026-11-27. Not installed or run in a GDH session.
